We need to determine crimes. Facts: Defendant sold counterfeit drugs (假药). Also he knew sellers had no license, allowed them to purchase and sell. So crime: production and sale of counterfeit drugs? He didn't produce, just sold. The charge is "生产、销售假药"? The rule: If manufacturing or distributing counterfeit drugs, the appropriate charge is “生产、销售假药” rather than th (maybe truncated). He is selling, not producing. But Chinese criminal law: "生产、销售假药罪" covers both production and sale. So charge: 生产、销售假药.

Also maybe "非法经营罪"? He sold without license. But the main is counterfeit drug. The facts mention he knowingly allowed sale of drugs without license. Could be "非法经营罪" (illegal business). However the rule says if facts describe manufacturing or distributing counterfeit drugs, charge is 生产、销售假药. So we list that.

Any other? He obtained proceeds from illegal sale, but that's part of same. No concealment. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]生产、销售假药<eoa>
